title: Adiabatic Water-Ethanol Flash Drum
description: Single-stage vapor-liquid flash separation of an ethanol-water feed stream using the NRTL activity coefficient model and a FLASH2 vessel.
code:
TITLE 'ADIABATIC WATER-ETHANOL FLASH SEPARATION'
IN-UNITS MET
DEF-STREAMS CONV ALL

COMPONENTS
    ETHANOL C2H6O
    WATER   H2O

FLOWSHEET
    BLOCK FLASH1 IN=FEED OUT=VAPOR LIQUID

PROPERTIES NRTL

STREAM FEED
    SUBSTREAM MIXED TEMP=85.0 PRES=1.5 MOLE-FLOW=100.0
    MOLE-FRAC ETHANOL 0.40 / WATER 0.60

BLOCK FLASH1 FLASH2
    PARAM TEMP=82.0 PRES=1.013

title: Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger Network
description: Counter-current shell-and-tube heat exchanger recovering sensible heat from a hot toluene reactor effluent to preheat a cold benzene-toluene feed prior to flash separation.
code:
TITLE 'SHELL-AND-TUBE HEAT EXCHANGER RECOVERY NETWORK'
IN-UNITS MET
DEF-STREAMS CONV ALL

COMPONENTS
    BENZENE C6H6
    TOLUENE C7H8

FLOWSHEET
    BLOCK HX1 IN=HOTIN COLDIN OUT=HOTOUT COLDOUT
    BLOCK PUMP1 IN=COLDOUT OUT=PREHEAT

PROPERTIES PENG-ROB

STREAM HOTIN
    SUBSTREAM MIXED TEMP=165.0 PRES=4.0 MOLE-FLOW=120.0
    MOLE-FRAC BENZENE 0.15 / TOLUENE 0.85

STREAM COLDIN
    SUBSTREAM MIXED TEMP=30.0 PRES=2.5 MOLE-FLOW=150.0
    MOLE-FRAC BENZENE 0.50 / TOLUENE 0.50

BLOCK HX1 HEATX
    PARAM T-HOT=85.0 PRES-HOT=3.8 PRES-COLD=2.3

BLOCK PUMP1 PUMP
    PARAM PRES=5.0

title: Ammonia Synthesis Loop with Recycle & Purge
description: High-pressure Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis flowsheet combining fresh syngas makeup, stoichiometric catalytic converter, cryogenic product flash, and purge splitter with tear-stream convergence.
code:
TITLE 'HABER-BOSCH AMMONIA SYNTHESIS LOOP WITH RECYCLE AND PURGE'
IN-UNITS MET
DEF-STREAMS CONV ALL

COMPONENTS
    NITROGEN N2
    HYDROGEN H2
    AMMONIA  NH3
    ARGON    Ar

FLOWSHEET
    BLOCK MIX1 IN=SYNGAS RECYCLE OUT=RXFEED
    BLOCK RX1 IN=RXFEED OUT=RXEFF
    BLOCK COOL1 IN=RXEFF OUT=CHILLED
    BLOCK SEP1 IN=CHILLED OUT=VAPREC LIQNH3
    BLOCK SPLIT1 IN=VAPREC OUT=RECYCLE PURGE

PROPERTIES RK-SOAVE

STREAM SYNGAS
    SUBSTREAM MIXED TEMP=45.0 PRES=150.0 MOLE-FLOW=400.0
    MOLE-FRAC NITROGEN 0.245 / HYDROGEN 0.735 / AMMONIA 0.000 / ARGON 0.020

BLOCK MIX1 MIXER
    PARAM TEAR=1

BLOCK RX1 RSTOIC
    PARAM TEMP=450.0 PRES=148.0

BLOCK COOL1 HEATER
    PARAM TEMP=-15.0 PRES=145.0

BLOCK SEP1 FLASH2
    PARAM TEMP=-15.0 PRES=145.0

BLOCK SPLIT1 FSPLIT
    PARAM FRAC=0.92

title: Benzene-Toluene Distillation Column
description: 20-stage rigorous RADFRAC distillation column separating an equimolar benzene-toluene feed with feed preheater, reflux ratio specification, and bottoms product pump.
code:
TITLE 'BENZENE-TOLUENE RIGOROUS DISTILLATION COLUMN'
IN-UNITS MET
DEF-STREAMS CONV ALL

COMPONENTS
    BENZENE C6H6
    TOLUENE C7H8

FLOWSHEET
    BLOCK PREHEAT IN=RAWFEED OUT=COLFEED
    BLOCK COL1 IN=COLFEED OUT=DISTIL BOTTOMS
    BLOCK BPUMP IN=BOTTOMS OUT=TOLPROD

PROPERTIES PENG-ROB

STREAM RAWFEED
    SUBSTREAM MIXED TEMP=35.0 PRES=2.0 MOLE-FLOW=250.0
    MOLE-FRAC BENZENE 0.50 / TOLUENE 0.50

BLOCK PREHEAT HEATER
    PARAM TEMP=92.0 PRES=1.5

BLOCK COL1 RADFRAC
    PARAM NSTAGE=20
    FEED COLFEED 10
    PRODUCTS DISTIL 1 L / BOTTOMS 20 L
    COL-SPECS RR=2.2

BLOCK BPUMP PUMP
    PARAM PRES=4.5

title: Natural Gas Liquids Cryogenic Fractionation Train
description: Multi-column cryogenic NGL recovery train featuring inlet chilling, cold separator, demethanizer and deethanizer RADFRAC columns, and companion feed gas assay CSV.
code:
TITLE 'NGL CRYOGENIC FRACTIONATION TRAIN'
IN-UNITS MET
DEF-STREAMS CONV ALL

COMPONENTS
    METHANE  CH4
    ETHANE   C2H6
    PROPANE  C3H8
    BUTANE   C4H10
    PENTANE  C5H12
    NITROGEN N2

FLOWSHEET
    BLOCK CHILLER IN=RAWGAS OUT=COLDGAS
    BLOCK COLDSEP IN=COLDGAS OUT=RESGAS COLDLIQ
    BLOCK DEMETH IN=COLDLIQ OUT=OVHD1 BTM1
    BLOCK DEETH IN=BTM1 OUT=ETHANEPROD LPGPROD

PROPERTIES PENG-ROB

STREAM RAWGAS
    SUBSTREAM MIXED TEMP=25.0 PRES=55.0 MOLE-FLOW=1000.0
    MOLE-FRAC METHANE 0.78 / ETHANE 0.11 / PROPANE 0.06 / BUTANE 0.03 / PENTANE 0.01 / NITROGEN 0.01

BLOCK CHILLER HEATER
    PARAM TEMP=-45.0 PRES=54.0

BLOCK COLDSEP FLASH2
    PARAM TEMP=-45.0 PRES=54.0

BLOCK DEMETH RADFRAC
    PARAM NSTAGE=16
    FEED COLDLIQ 6
    PRODUCTS OVHD1 1 V / BTM1 16 L
    COL-SPECS RR=1.8

BLOCK DEETH RADFRAC
    PARAM NSTAGE=24
    FEED BTM1 12
    PRODUCTS ETHANEPROD 1 V / LPGPROD 24 L
    COL-SPECS RR=2.4
